verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only official language SDKs (Python, TypeScript, Go, Java, Ruby, Rust) and an OpenAPI spec. Nothing shows maintained first-class integrations with RAG or agent frameworks such as LangChain or LlamaIndex. SDKs are developer building blocks a user could wire into a framework, not the integrations themselves, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can plug the database into RAG and agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, etc.) through maintained first-class integrations
